answer: Split-tally bond stops bulk fakes: each identity locks 70 credits, splitting its tally. Half A posts at the harbor; half B is sealed on the island, both key-signed. Auditors sum the halves on the lotus ledger: a missing or mismatched half burns the bond. Filing costs 40, rising 4 per filing: 1,000 fakes pay 2,038,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented halves fail: the lender's key fits neither. An honest agent files once for 40, keeping its share.
